claims.conditions: A person decides the current conversation should continue in a fresh session and invokes the skill, optionally describing what the next session is for. The agent can write to the operating system's temporary directory.
claims.rationale: The frontmatter sets disable-model-invocation: true, so the source itself reserves the trigger to the person. The body directs one write: a hand-off document summarising the conversation, saved to the OS temporary directory and 'not the current workspace' (line 8), with a section naming skills the next agent should load (line 10), references to existing artifacts instead of copies (line 12), redaction of sensitive information (line 14), and tailoring to the stated purpose of the next session (line 16). The person chooses when to compact and what the next session is for; the agent only writes. Plausible failure modes: the temporary directory is machine-local and may not outlive a reboot or a cloud container, so the document can be gone when the next session starts; redaction depends on the model recognising what is sensitive; the suggested-skills section carries the first session's assumptions into the next as recommendations. Falsified if the document is written into the workspace or produced without a person's invocation in a harness that honours the frontmatter flag.
